info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Authorities Information API
info.description: The Regulatory Authorities Information API provides access to vital data regarding regulatory bodies overseeing corporate relations within the banking sector. By utilizing this API, users can retrieve comprehensive listings of regulatory authorities, including their roles and responsibilities. This endpoint is particularly valuable for financial institutions, compliance officers, and risk management teams seeking to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements. It facilitates informed decision-making and enhances understanding of the regulatory landscape affecting corporate banking activities.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of regulatory authorities.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current list of regulatory authorities relevant to corporate relations. It provides essential information needed for compliance and governance.
